name: sonic-playground
description: Sonic Playground: a hand-picked music journal. Static Zola site on GitHub Pages, Flowbite Pro UI, catalogue derived from front matter.
author: Tomas Korcak

scripts.assets: npm run --silent vendor && npm run --silent css
scripts.build: npm run --silent assets && npm run --silent check && zola build
scripts.dev: npm run --silent assets && npm run --silent derive && zola serve
